The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} is equipped in the {{Icon|axe}} slot and is used when chopping down trees for [[log]]s or when splitting wood at the [[chopping spot]].  The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} must be forged at the [[anvil II]] by the player and isn't available for sale.

Efficiency reflects how much progress toward a task each use of a tool provides. An efficiency of 100% would be full speed, 200% would be double speed, and 50% would be half speed. The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} is 150% efficient.

Energy usage reflects how much energy each action consumes. The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} consumes {{Energy||1}} per swing.

Studying {{PAGENAME}} at the [[Study table]] will give you {{Techpoint|Red|100}}.
